result.instructions: Tools for Eden AI, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which LLM models on Eden AI support function calling and cost the least per token?"; "Extract the text from this scanned invoice with OCR."; "Ask a Claude model to summarise this paragraph in three bullet points.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Eden AI data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run eden_ai_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run eden_ai_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run eden_ai_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. eden_ai_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: eden_ai_list_models
tools.title: List LLM models
tools.description: List the LLM chat models available through Eden AI, with context length, pricing, regions and capabilities. Use the returned id as the `model` of eden_ai_chat. Eden AI API: GET /v3/models.

q.description: Match the model name or provider, for example 'claude' or 'mistral'.

owned_by.description: Only models from these providers, for example 'anthropic,openai', comma-separated (for example "a,b").

capabilities.description: Only models with these capability flags, without the supports_ prefix (for example function_calling,reasoning), comma-separated (for example "a,b").

zero_data_retention.description: Only models whose provider keeps no data.

tools.name: eden_ai_list_features
tools.title: List expert features
tools.description: List the expert-model features (OCR, text, image, web, translation, audio, video) and their subfeatures. Use it to find the `feature/subfeature` for eden_ai_run_expert. Eden AI API: GET /v3/info.

include_schemas.description: Also return each subfeature's request and output schema (larger response).

tools.name: eden_ai_get_feature
tools.title: Get expert feature details
tools.description: Get one expert feature (its subfeatures) or one subfeature (its providers, models, pricing and input/output schemas). Pass `subfeature` for the schemas. Eden AI API: GET /v3/info/{feature} or GET /v3/info/{feature}/{subfeature}.

format.description: Schema format when `subfeature` is set (default simplified).

tools.name: eden_ai_chat
tools.title: Chat with an LLM (billed)
tools.description: Send a chat request to an LLM through Eden AI and return the reply (OpenAI-compatible response: choices[0].message.content). Each call is billed to the account. Find model ids with eden_ai_list_models. Eden AI API: POST /v3/chat/completions.

messages.description: The conversation so far, oldest first. The last message is usually the user's.

max_tokens.description: Upper limit on the reply length in tokens.

tools.name: eden_ai_run_expert
tools.title: Run an expert model (billed)
tools.description: Run one expert model synchronously (OCR, moderation, translation, speech, image and more) and return its result. Each call is billed to the account. `model` is 'feature/subfeature/provider', for example 'text/moderation/google'; `input` depends on the feature (see eden_ai_get_feature with `subfeature`). Eden AI API: POST /v3/universal-ai.

model.description: Feature, subfeature and provider joined by '/', for example 'text/moderation/google'.

input.description: The feature's input object, for example { "text": "..." } for text moderation.

provider_params.description: Provider-specific parameters that are not in the unified schema.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Eden AI
prompts.description: What you can do with Eden AI here, with example requests to try.
